title: eDNA Extraction Protocol Using STERIVEX Capsule
author: delphine.vanhaecke Vanhaecke
materials: Handshake SX filter capsules vigorously before processing.

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Materials
steps.instruction: Decontaminate the work area and sterilize necessary labware.

substeps.instruction: Clean the laminar flow hood and micropipettes with DNAZAP, then wipe with ddH2O and 70% Ethanol using tissue paper.
Place gloves, sleeves, 1.5 mL (8) and 2.0 mL (24) sterilized LoBind tubes in the laminar flow hood and expose to UV light for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Filter Capsules
steps.instruction: Decontaminate the exterior of the Sterivex capsules and remove the storage buffer.

substeps.instruction: Wipe the outer surfaces of all filter capsules with 5% bleach using clean tissue paper, then dry and wipe with 70% Ethanol.
Remove the yellow inlet caps from the capsules.
Use a 3 mL Luer-Lock syringe to transfer the buffer from the filter capsule into a 2 mL sterile LoBind tube, avoiding excessive pressure.
Dry the filters in a fume hood by placing them vertically (yellow cap side facing down) on clean laboratory tissue paper.

steps.title: Store Buffer for Analysis
steps.instruction: Label and store the extracted EtOH buffer at -80°C, as it contains eDNA from the sample.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Working Solution
steps.instruction: Create a lysis premix immediately before the lysis step.

substeps.instruction: In a 10 mL sterilized tube, mix 900 μL ATL buffer and 100 μL proteinase K per sample (including one negative DNA extraction control).
For 8 samples plus 1 control (9 total), prepare 8100 μL ATL buffer and 900 μL Prot K.

steps.title: Apply Lysis Solution to Filters
steps.instruction: Add the lysis premix to the Sterivex filters and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the red outlet cap remains closed.
Using a 1,000 μL micropipet and sterile tips, carefully add 1000 μL Lysis working solution between the outside of the filter and the capsule walls.
Close with a yellow inlet cap and seal with parafilm.
Handshake vigorously for a few seconds.
Transfer the cartridge to a sterile petri dish and place in an incubator preheated to 56°C for 24 hours without rotating, shaking vigorously periodically.

steps.title: Recover Lysis Mixture
steps.instruction: Extract the liquid from the capsules and prepare for purification.

substeps.instruction: Use a 2 mL Luer Lock syringe to remove ALL liquid from the yellow inlet end of the capsule.
Measure the volume and transfer it into two separate 2 mL LoBind tubes (e.g., sample 1a and 1b, each containing 500 μL).
Vortex for a few seconds and spin down for 2 seconds to sediment excess debris.

steps.title: Prepare Binding Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the ethanol/buffer mixture for DNA binding.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 10 mL of molecular grade ethanol (99.9%) in a 25 mL sterile eppendorf tube and store at -20°C.

Add Buffer AL and ice-cold molecular grade 99% ethanol (Thermo Fisher Scientific) to the sample in equal volumes (Sample:Buffer:Ethanol = 1:1:1). For example, add 1000 μL of a premixed AL+EtOH mix to 500 μL of lysis mix.

steps.title: Purify DNA via Spin Column
steps.instruction: Filter the mixture through a DNeasy Mini Spin column.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the mixture vigorously.
Pipet the mixture (max 600 μL at a time) into a DNeasy Mini Spin column in a 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge preferably at 4°C at 8000 rpm for 1 min.
Repeat the vortexing and centrifugation steps until all sample is filtered.

steps.title: Wash DNA Membrane
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane to remove contaminants and dry the column.

substeps.instruction: Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 μL Buffer AW1, and centrifuge for 1 min at 8,000 rpm; discard flow-through and tube.
Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 μL Buffer AW2, and centrifuge for 3 min at 14,000 rpm to dry the membrane.
Label eight 1.5 mL LoBind tubes during this process.

steps.title: Elute eDNA
steps.instruction: Release the DNA from the membrane using heated buffer.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a labeled 1.5 mL DNA LoBind tube.
Heat Buffer AE (pH 8.0) to 70°C on a thermomixer.
Place tubes with spin columns (four at a time) on a 70°C heating plate and add 75 μL of 70°C Buffer AE to the membrane.
Immediately remove from the heating plate and let stand at Room Temperature for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 8,000 rpm and discard the spin column.

steps.title: Aliquot and Store eDNA
steps.instruction: Divide the eluate for immediate use and long-term storage.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 30 μL of eluate eDNA into a separate labeled PCR tube; store in a dark room refrigerator at 4°C for immediate use (max 6 months).
Store the remaining 45 μL of eluate eDNA (STOCK) at -80°C.
